content.text: May be given if ARDS is from a steroid-responsive process (eg, acute eosinophilic pneumonia), or w refractory sepsis or CAP; generally avoided in less severe ARDS or ARDS persisting beyond 14 days; worse outcomes w certain viral infections, incl influenza.
